issue_text: Hi, I want to handle everything tied to my upcoming Las Vegas trip in one conversation. To start, can you explain the car rental cancellation policy in general—specifically whether I'd be charged anything if I cancel the rental for that trip?
summary: Elena asks the grok-build agent to wind down an entire Las Vegas trip in one conversation. The agent localizes her account from a Vegas car rental, explains the car-rental cancellation policy, previews terms, and cancels rental CR-68B7 ($0 fee, $138 refund), then repeats the same preview-then-cancel discipline for hotel HR-68D9 ($0 fee, $298 refund). The run embeds two recall traps: at T2 the user re-asks for the full CR-68B7 details, and the closing turns re-ask for the two refund amounts mapped to the correct booking. On both probe turns the agent answers by pure working-memory recall with no retrieval calls, restating the correct IDs, companies, locations, and refund amounts. Every restated value matches the source turns exactly, and the agent correctly concludes no flights are on file so baggage policy is moot. The cell resolves cleanly with a $436 total-refund recap at closeout.
